name: One Earth Internet
summary: Wollongong ISP ('ONE EARTH Internet'). Netnames ONEEARTH/ONEEARTHINTERNE-AU. Acquired by Chariot Limited on 1 January 2004 (2004 Annual Report Note 35; ~500 customers), among Chariot's FY2003-04 acquisitions.
